blocks.text: AI product photography and on-model imagery built specifically for apparel brands

If your store sells clothing, the priciest repeatable bottleneck is not email or support: it is getting every product photographed on a model. WearView handles exactly that with AI. Upload a flat-lay or a plain garment photo, and it puts that exact piece on a realistic model, keeping the prints, texture, and any printed text true to what actually ships.

Because it was built for apparel rather than general image generation, the model, the garment, and the lighting stay consistent across a whole collection, so a product grid looks like one planned shoot instead of a patchwork of stock faces. The same upload can become a ghost-mannequin product shot, a flat-lay turned on-model, extra pose variations, or a short model video for Reels and TikTok, so the catalog and the social cut-downs come out of one tool with commercial rights included.
For a full breakdown of pricing tiers, pros and cons, and how WearView compares to booking a studio shoot, see our dedicated WearView page.
Garment or flat-lay in, on-model photo out in about 30 seconds
Reuse one model across a full catalog, plus pose control for angle variations
Hollow-body product shots and restyling of existing photos
Turns product stills into short 720p/1080p social clips
High-resolution exports up to 4K with commercial usage rights on paid plans

WearView is the only tool in this list built specifically for apparel: it keeps prints and garment fit accurate on a consistent AI model instead of generating a generic AI lookalike. For brands shooting a full catalog, that consistency is the difference between a coherent product grid and a patchwork of one-off renders.
Our team can integrate WearView into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
